newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Wheat planting advances.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Wheat planting advances.

text.p: Cash spring wheat bids were lower Monday but farmers' attention was directed to planting rather than selling grain, spring wheat dealers said.

Dealers said planting was under way in eastern South Dakota, western North Dakota and Montana. Some dealers said parts of the Red River Valley in North Dakota should be dry soon to allow for planting.
In its weekly crop progress report, USDA reported spring wheat was 13 percent planted versus five a week ago and 21 a year ago.
There was also scant movement in the Pacific Northwest.
MGE spring wheat settled nine to 11 cents lower with July off nine cents at $4.26 a bushel.
